def user_home_root: "/" + "Users" + "/";
# A quoted root literal is a search pattern; concrete descendants still fail.
def has_private_home_path:
  contains(user_home_root) and . != user_home_root and
  (split("\"" + user_home_root + "\"") | join("") |
   split("'" + user_home_root + "'") | join("") | contains(user_home_root));

reduce inputs as $event (
  {schema_version:null,status:null,runtime_commit:null,
   source_status:null,source_commit:null,source_gate_count:null,source_freeze_commit:null,
   invalid_summary_status:0,public_cases:0,public_rows:0,direct_cases:0,direct_rows:0,
   full43_records:0,full43_failed_records:0,full43_complete:false,full43_result_validation:false,
   full43_shared_native_plan_reports:0,full43_shared_native_plan_runs:null,
   public_raw_envelopes:0,direct_raw_envelopes:0,full43_native_logs:0,
   public_complete_value_proofs:0,public_complete_value_rows:0,
   public_resource_proofs:0,public_resource_budget_entries:0,public_resource_peak_entries:0,
   invalid_resource_peaks:0,invalid_resource_budgets:0,invalid_resource_peak_fields:0,
   public_denial_proofs:0,native_schema_proofs:0,literal_oracles:0,
   envelope_fallback_true:0,envelope_field_fallback_true:0,last_envelope_field_key:null,
   invalid_envelope_status:0,private_path_strings:0,source_assets:0,
   claim_fallback_true:0,claim_external_engine_true:0,performance_claim_true:0,
   hosted_acceptance_pending:null,broader_work_complete:null,archive_members_reopened:null};
  if ($event | length) != 2 then . else
    $event[0] as $p | $event[1] as $v |
    if $p == ["schema_version"] then .schema_version = $v
    elif $p == ["status"] then .status = $v
    elif $p == ["runtime_commit"] then .runtime_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","status"] then .source_status = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","source_commit"] then .source_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","gate_count"] then .source_gate_count = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","source_freeze","source_commit"] then .source_freeze_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["public","summary","status"] or $p == ["direct_unary","summary","status"] then
      if $v != "passed" then .invalid_summary_status += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[1:3] == ["summary","cases"] and $p[4] == "name" then
      if $p[0] == "public" then .public_cases += 1
      elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_cases += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[1:3] == ["summary","cases"] and $p[4] == "complete_rows_verified" then
      if $p[0] == "public" then .public_rows += $v
      elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_rows += $v else . end
    elif $p == ["full43","summary","complete"] then .full43_complete = $v
    elif $p == ["full43","summary","full_result_validation"] then .full43_result_validation = $v
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[0:3] == ["full43","summary","records"] and $p[4] == "passed" then
      .full43_records += 1 | if $v != true then .full43_failed_records += 1 else . end
    elif $p == ["full43","shared_native_plan_family_verified_runs"] then .full43_shared_native_plan_runs = $v
    elif ($p|length) == 7 and $p[0:2] == ["full43","raw_logs"] and $p[3:5] == ["envelope","fields"] and $p[6] == "value" and $v == "native_vortex_unified_plan" then
      .full43_shared_native_plan_reports += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "kind" then
      .public_complete_value_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "complete_rows" then
      .public_complete_value_rows += $v
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] and $p[3] == "peak_reserved_bytes" then
      .public_resource_peak_entries += 1 | .public_resource_proofs += 1 |
      if ($v|type) != "number" or $v < 0 or $v > (if ($p[2]|contains("-convert-")) then 4 else 1 end) * 1073741824 then .invalid_resource_peaks += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] and $p[3] == "budget_gb" then
      .public_resource_budget_entries += 1 |
      if ($v|type) != "number" or $v != (if ($p[2]|contains("-convert-")) then 4 else 1 end) then .invalid_resource_budgets += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] and $p[3] == "peak_field" then
      if (["native_vortex_array_sink_peak_reserved_bytes","resident_peak_reserved_buffer_bytes"] | index($v)) == null then .invalid_resource_peak_fields += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","denial_proofs"] and $p[3] == "sha256" then .public_denial_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","complete_native_schema_proofs"] and $p[3] == "raw_sha256" then .native_schema_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 3 and $p[0] == "literal_core_and_typed_oracles" and $p[2] == "sha256" then .literal_oracles += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3:5] == ["envelope","status"] then
      (if $p[0] == "public" then .public_raw_envelopes += 1
       elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_raw_envelopes += 1
       elif $p[0] == "full43" then .full43_native_logs += 1 else . end) |
      if (["success","error","unsupported"] | index($v)) == null then .invalid_envelope_status += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) >= 7 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3] == "envelope" and ($p|index("fields")) != null and $p[-1] == "key" then
      .last_envelope_field_key = $v
    elif ($p|length) >= 7 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3] == "envelope" and ($p|index("fields")) != null and $p[-1] == "value" then
      .last_envelope_field_key as $field |
      if (($field | type) == "string"
          and (["fallback_attempted","external_engine_invoked","external_query_engine_invoked","fallback_execution_allowed"] | any(. as $suffix | $field | endswith($suffix)))
          and $v != false and $v != "false") then .envelope_field_fallback_true += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 6 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3:6] == ["envelope","fallback","attempted"] then
      if $v != false then .envelope_fallback_true += 1 else . end

"""Independently inspect every portable packet event through the system JSON parser."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--inspection', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert all(value.isascii() and value.isdecimal() and int(value) > 0
           for value in (args.attempt, args.inspection))

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

receipt_path = OUT/f'nested-pivot-final-core-acceptance-{args.attempt}.json'
receipt = read(receipt_path)
assert receipt['status'] == 'passed_core_local'
packet_path = Path(receipt['packet'])
assert packet_path.stat().st_size == receipt['packet_compressed_bytes']
assert sha(packet_path) == receipt['packet_sha256']
script = OUT/'inspect_nested_pivot_packet.jq'
contract_path = OUT/'nested-pivot-inspector-contract-tests-1.json'
contract = read(contract_path)
assert contract['status'] == 'passed' and contract['runtime_executed'] is False
assert (contract['case_count'], contract['normal_field_cases'], contract['private_path_case_count']) == (72, 3, 11)
assert contract['query_sha256'] == sha(script)
start = time.monotonic()
digest, byte_count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
process = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/jq', '-n', '--stream', '-f', str(script)],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
try:
    with lzma.open(packet_path, 'rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1 << 20):
            process.stdin.write(chunk)
            digest.update(chunk)
            byte_count += len(chunk)
    process.stdin.close()
    process.stdin = None
    stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=180)
except BaseException:
    process.kill()
    process.communicate()
    raise
assert process.returncode == 0 and not stderr, (process.returncode, stderr)
assert byte_count == receipt['packet_uncompressed_bytes']
assert digest.hexdigest() == receipt['packet_uncompressed_sha256']
observed = json.loads(stdout)
expected = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.native_nested_pivot_state_acceptance.v1',
    'status': 'passed_core_local', 'runtime_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'source_status': 'passed_core_source', 'source_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'source_freeze_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'], 'source_gate_count': 27,
    'public_cases': 27373, 'public_rows': 15820181,
    'direct_cases': 202, 'direct_rows': 131734,
    'full43_records': 129, 'full43_failed_records': 0,
    'full43_complete': True, 'full43_result_validation': True,
    'full43_shared_native_plan_reports': 129, 'full43_shared_native_plan_runs': 129,
    'full43_native_logs': 129, 'literal_oracles': 2, 'source_assets': 910,
    'public_complete_value_proofs': 2871, 'public_complete_value_rows': 468657,
    'public_resource_proofs': 2871, 'public_resource_budget_entries': 2871,
    'public_resource_peak_entries': 2871, 'public_denial_proofs': 716,
    'native_schema_proofs': 1892,
    'public_raw_envelopes': receipt['public_raw_envelopes'],
    'direct_raw_envelopes': receipt['direct_raw_envelopes'],
    'hosted_acceptance_pending': True, 'broader_work_complete': False,
    'archive_members_reopened': 516,
}
zero_fields = ('invalid_summary_status', 'invalid_resource_peaks',
    'invalid_resource_budgets', 'invalid_resource_peak_fields', 'envelope_fallback_true',
    'envelope_field_fallback_true', 'invalid_envelope_status', 'private_path_strings',
    'claim_fallback_true', 'claim_external_engine_true', 'performance_claim_true')
expected.update(dict.fromkeys(zero_fields, 0))
assert observed == expected, {key: (observed.get(key), value)
                             for key, value in expected.items() if observed.get(key) != value}
proof = {
    'status': 'passed', 'runtime_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'packet_sha256': sha(packet_path), 'packet_uncompressed_sha256': digest.hexdigest(),
    'packet_uncompressed_bytes': byte_count, 'acceptance_receipt_sha256': sha(receipt_path),
    'inspection_parser': '/usr/bin/jq',
    'inspection_program_sha256': sha(script), 'driver_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
    'inspector_contract_tests': {'sha256': sha(contract_path), 'report': contract},
    'seconds': time.monotonic()-start, 'observed': observed,
    'scope': 'Independent streaming parse, exact case/row/proof counts, all raw envelope fallback fields and portable-path boundary; complete value comparisons are retained in the acceptance packet.'
}
target = OUT/f'nested-pivot-independent-packet-inspection-{args.inspection}.json'
with target.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(proof, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(proof, indent=2), flush=True)
